Mahw-e-tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar hai har woh cheez jo zameen o aasmaan mein hai, aur woh Parwardigar saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Aasmaan o zameen ka kul ikhtiyaar usi ke paas hai, aur wahi hayaat o maut ka dene waala hai aur har shai par ikhtiyaar rakhne waala hai
Wahi awwal hai, wahi aakhir, wahi zaahir hai, wahi baatin, aur wahi har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Wahi woh hai jis ne zameen o aasmaan ko chhe din mein paida kiya hai aur phir Arsh par apna iqtidaar qaaim kiya hai. Woh har us cheez ko jaanta hai jo zameen mein daakhil hoti hai ya zameen se khaarij hoti hai, aur jo cheez aasmaan se naazil hoti hai aur aasmaan ki taraf buland hoti hai, aur woh tumhaare saath hai tum jahaan bhi raho, aur woh tumhaare aamaal ka dekhne waala hai
Aasmaan o zameen ka mulk usi ke liye hai, aur tamaam umoor ki baazgasht usi ki taraf hai
Woh raat ko din mein aur din ko raat mein daakhil karta hai, aur woh seenon ke raazon se bhi baakhabar hai

Tum log Allah o Rasool par imaan le aao aur us maal mein se kharch karo jis mein us ne tumhein apna naaib qaraar diya hai. Tum mein se jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne raah-e-Khuda mein kharch kiya un ke liye ajr-e-azeem hai

Aur tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum Khuda par imaan nahin laate ho jab ke Rasool tumhein daawat de raha hai ke apne Parwardigar par imaan le aao, aur Khuda tum se is baat ka ahd bhi le chuka hai agar tum etibaar karne waale ho

Wahi woh hai jo apne bande par khuli hui nishaaniyaan naazil karta hai taake tumhein taareekiyon se noor ki taraf nikaal kar le aaye, aur Allah tumhaare haal par yaqeenan meharbaan o rahm karne waala hai

Aur tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum raah-e-Khuda mein kharch nahin karte ho jab ke aasmaan o zameen ki wiraasat usi ke liye hai. Aur tum mein se fatah se pehle infaaq karne waala aur jihaad karne waala us ke jaisa nahin ho sakta hai jo fatah ke baad infaaq aur jihaad kare. Pehle jihaad karne waale ka darja bahut buland hai, agarche Khuda ne sab se neki ka waada kiya hai, aur woh tumhaare jumla aamaal se baakhabar hai
Kaun hai jo Allah ko qarz-e-hasana de ke woh us ko doguna kar de aur us ke liye ba-izzat ajr bhi ho

Us din tum ba-imaan mard aur ba-imaan auraton ko dekhoge ke un ka noor-e-imaan un ke aage aage aur daahini taraf chal raha hai, aur un se kaha ja raha hai ke aaj tumhaari bashaarat ka saamaan woh baaghaat hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain, aur tum hamesha unhi mein rehne waale ho, aur yahi sab se badi kaamyaabi hai

Us din munaafiq mard aur munaafiq auratein saahibaan-e-imaan se kahenge ke zara hamaari taraf bhi nazar-e-marhamat karo ke hum tumhaare noor se istifaada karein. To un se kaha jaaega ke apne peechhe ki taraf palat jaao aur apne shayaateen se noor ki iltimaas karo. Us ke baad un ke darmiyaan ek deewaar haail kar di jaaegi jis ke andar ki taraf rehmat hogi aur baahar ki taraf azaab hoga

Aur munaafiqeen imaan waalon se pukaar kar kahenge ke kya hum tumhaare saath nahin the? To woh kahenge beshak, magar tum ne apne ko balaaon mein mubtala kar diya aur hamaare liye masaaib ke muntazir rahe aur tum ne risaalat mein shak kiya, aur tumhein tamannaaon ne dhoke mein daale rakha yahaan tak ke hukm-e-Khuda aa gaya, aur tumhein dhokebaaz Shaitaan ne dhoka diya hai
To aaj na tum se koi fidya liya jaaega aur na kuffaar se. Tum sab ka thikaana Jahannam hai, wahi tum sab ka saahib-e-ikhtiyaar hai aur tumhaara badtareen anjaam hai

Kya saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye abhi woh waqt nahin aaya hai ke un ke dil zikr-e-Khuda aur us ki taraf se naazil hone waale haq ke liye narm ho jaayein, aur woh un ahl-e-kitaab ki tarah na ho jaayein jinhein kitaab di gayi to ek arsa guzarne ke baad un ke dil sakht ho gaye aur un ki aksariyat badkaar ho gayi
Yaad rakho ke Khuda murda zameenon ka zinda karne waala hai, aur hum ne tamaam nishaaniyon ko waazeh kar ke bayaan kar diya hai taake tum aql se kaam le sako

Beshak khairaat karne waale mard aur khairaat karne waali auratein, aur jinhon ne raah-e-Khuda mein ikhlaas ke saath maal kharch kiya hai, un ka ajr doguna kar diya jaaega aur un ke liye bada ba-izzat ajr hai

Aur jo log Allah aur Rasool par imaan laaye wahi Khuda ke nazdeek siddeeq aur shaheed ka darja rakhte hain, aur unhi ke liye un ka ajr aur noor hai. Aur jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya aur hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb kar di wahi dar-asal ashaab-e-Jahannam hain

Yaad rakho ke zindagi-e-duniya sirf ek khel, tamaasha, aaraaish, baahami tafaakhur aur amwaal o aulaad ki kasrat ka muqaabla hai, aur bas. Jaise koi baarish ho jis ki quwwat-e-naamiya kisaan ko khush kar de aur us ke baad woh khaiti khushk ho jaaye, phir tum use zard dekho aur aakhir mein woh reza reza ho jaaye. Aur aakhirat mein shadeed azaab bhi hai aur maghfirat aur razaa-e-Ilaahi bhi hai, aur zindagaani-e-duniya to bas ek dhoke ka sarmaaya hai aur kuch nahin hai

Tum sab apne Parwardigar ki maghfirat aur us Jannat ki taraf sabqat karo jis ki wus'at zameen o aasmaan ke baraabar hai, aur jise un logon ke liye muhayya kiya gaya hai jo Khuda aur Rasool par imaan laaye hain. Yahi dar-haqeeqat fazl-e-Khuda hai, jise chaahta hai ata kar deta hai, aur Allah to bahut bade fazl ka maalik hai

Zameen mein koi bhi museebat waarid hoti hai ya tumhaare nafs par naazil hoti hai to nafs ke paida hone se pehle se woh Kitaab-e-Ilaahi mein muqaddar ho chuki hai, aur yeh Khuda ke liye bahut aasaan shai hai
Yeh taqdeer is liye hai ke jo tumhaare haath se nikal jaaye us ka afsos na karo aur jo mil jaaye us par ghuroor na karo, ke Allah akadne waale maghroor afraad ko pasand nahin karta hai
Jo khud bhi bukhl karte hain aur doosron ko bhi bukhl ka hukm dete hain, aur jo bhi Khuda se roo-gardaani karega use maaloom rahe ke Khuda sab se be-niyaaz aur qaabil-e-hamd o sataaish hai

Beshak hum ne apne rasoolon ko waazeh dalaail ke saath bheja hai aur un ke saath kitaab aur meezaan ko naazil kiya hai taake log insaaf ke saath qiyaam karein, aur hum ne lohe ko bhi naazil kiya hai jis mein shadeed jang ka saamaan aur bahut se doosre manaafe bhi hain, aur is liye ke Khuda yeh dekhe ke kaun hai jo baghair dekhe us ki aur us ke Rasool ki madad karta hai, aur yaqeenan Allah bada saahib-e-quwwat aur saahib-e-izzat hai
Aur hum ne Nooh alaihis-salaam aur Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ko bheja aur un ki aulaad mein kitaab aur nubuwwat qaraar di, to un mein se kuch hidaayat-yaafta the aur bahut se faasiq aur badkaar the

Phir hum ne unhi ke naqsh-e-qadam par doosre rasool bheje aur un ke peechhe Eesa bin Maryam alaihis-salaam ko bheja aur unhein Injeel ata kar di, aur un ka ittibaa' karne waalon ke dilon mein meharbaani aur mohabbat qaraar de di. Aur jis ruhbaaniyat ko un logon ne az-khud eejaad kar liya tha aur us se razaa-e-Khuda ke talabgaar the use hum ne un ke oopar farz nahin qaraar diya tha, aur unhon ne khud bhi us ki mukammal paasdaari nahin ki. To hum ne un mein se waaqai imaan laane waalon ko ajr ata kar diya, aur un mein se bahut se to bilkul faasiq aur badkirdaar the

Imaan waalo! Allah se daro aur Rasool par waaqai imaan le aao taake Khuda tumhein apni rehmat ke dohre hisse ata kar de aur tumhaare liye aisa noor qaraar de de jis ki raushni mein chal sako, aur tumhein bakhsh de, aur Allah bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Taake ahl-e-kitaab ko maaloom ho jaaye ke woh fazl-e-Khuda ke baare mein koi ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte hain, aur fazl tamaam-tar Khuda ke haath mein hai, woh jise chaahta hai ata kar deta hai, aur woh bahut bade fazl ka maalik hai
